title: Drawing standards profiles: ISO and ASME conventions for exported drawings and documents
description:
Owner 2026-10-05: exported schematics/drawings/documents follow no formal standard today (no ISO/ASME claims; only data citations like IEC 60807-3). Add selectable standards profiles per org/design:
- ISO profile: ISO 5457 sheet sizes/frames, ISO 7200 title block fields, ISO 128 line types/lettering, ISO 129-1 dimensioning, first-angle projection symbol, ISO 81346 reference designations.
- ASME profile: ASME Y14.1 sheet sizes (A-E), Y14.100 drawing practices and title block, Y14.5 dimensioning/tolerancing, Y14.35 revision block, Y14.24 drawing type (wire harness), third-angle projection symbol, Y14.44 reference designations.
- Schematic symbols: IEC 60617 (ISO profile) or IEEE 315 (ASME profile).
- Harness/build docs: IPC/WHMA-A-620 acceptance class (1/2/3) on build sheet and test spec; continuity/hipot test spec structured to A-620 test requirements.
- Wire/cable identification: IEC 62491 / SAE AS50881-style marking where applicable.
- Revision control on every sheet (rev letter, ECO/change history from change sets).
Deliver as conventions WireHub follows ('follows ISO 7200 fields'), not certification claims; verify against the actual standard texts before claiming. Module hook so a deployment can supply its own house profile/title block. Depends on the drawing-language spec (cs-48a).

An update that changes an image is not applied (the db copy wins) and a disable never removes them. Needs a record of which depiction files a pack owns (e.g. in packs.json added) and removal in pgSetupDeps.transact. Binary files under data/art/ of a pack are not staged on pg yet (none exist; JSON art is stored as docs).
notes: Done on fix/pack-depiction-ownership: packs.json assets (path->sha256), reconcile on update/disable (files merged layout + pg), pg staging of data/art binaries via new catalog-file change kind.
close_reason: Closed
